transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi, ConversalQ support! How can I help you?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I just signed up today. I have no idea where to start. Can you walk me through the basics?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Welcome aboard! Absolutely. There are 3 steps to get you up and running:

1. Set up your knowledge base — upload your FAQs, product docs, or policies so the AI can answer questions accurately.
2. Configure your agents — choose which specialist agents to activate (billing, technical, etc.).
3. Connect your channels — add your chat widget to your website or link your phone number via Twilio.

Do you want to start with the knowledge base?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Yes, how do I upload documents?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Go to Dashboard > Knowledge Base > Upload. You can upload PDFs, Word documents, or paste plain text. The system will automatically chunk and index it for your AI agents. Most documents are processed in under 2 minutes.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: We support PDF, DOCX, TXT, and Markdown files, up to 50MB per file. You can also paste URLs and we'll scrape the content for you.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: That's handy. And how do I add the chat widget to my website?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Go to Dashboard > Channels > Web Widget. You'll find a JavaScript snippet to paste into your site's HTML before the closing body tag. It takes about 2 minutes to install and no developer is required for most platforms.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Perfect. This is clearer than I expected. I think I can take it from here.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great! We also have a Getting Started guide at docs.conversalq.com/quickstart if you need a reference. Don't hesitate to call back if you have questions!
